parties: New Delhi Television Limited (NDTV) acquires GoodTimes Channel (business undertaking) from Lifestyle & Media Broadcasting Limited
headline: NDTV acquires GoodTimes Channel from Lifestyle & Media Broadcasting Limited
sum: NDTV has announced the acquisition of the GoodTimes Channel business undertaking from Lifestyle & Media Broadcasting Limited. The transaction represents NDTV's strategic expansion in the entertainment and lifestyle broadcasting segment.
implication: Business undertaking acquisitions in broadcasting trigger compliance with the Cable Television Networks Rules 1994, content licensing requirements under the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting framework, and potential FIPB approval if foreign investment is involved-critical gating factors for media M&A in India.
detail: NDTV formally disclosed to NSE the acquisition of GoodTimes Channel, a business undertaking held by Lifestyle & Media Broadcasting Limited. The transaction was disclosed as a general update to the stock exchange under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR), 2015, which mandates disclosure of material events. GoodTimes is positioned in the entertainment and lifestyle segment, complementing NDTV's existing broadcast portfolio. The specific consideration amount, acquisition completion date, and conditions precedent have not been publicly disclosed in available sources.

framework.note: Mandates disclosure of material acquisitions and material changes to stock exchange within 24 hours; NDTV's NSE filing triggers this requirement.
Governs operation and licensing of TV channels; acquisition transfers channel operating rights and compliance obligations.

Asset purchase accounting and capital gains treatment for the business undertaking transfer.

Compliance with Cable Television Networks (Regulation) Act, 1995
approvals: Ministry of Information & Broadcasting (channel license/content approval)
structure.novel: Business undertaking acquisition (not equity purchase) of a media/lifestyle channel; structure may preserve Lifestyle & Media Broadcasting's legal entity while transferring operational channel assets and liabilities.

triggers.note: Material acquisition requires 24-hour disclosure to NSE; NDTV's public announcement fulfilled this trigger.
Channel operating rights transfer requires Ministry of Information & Broadcasting approval; licensing change is mandatory and non-waivable.
If combined NDTV + GoodTimes turnover exceeds ₹2,250 cr, CCI merger notification and review is mandatory; acquisition cannot close until clearance.
